mentl/abe3f40:
A fn whose name is an op of a linked effect is unreachable — every call
performs the op — and the body is judged against the op's signature, so the
only symptom was `Int vs () -> t...` at the author's own call, naming a
shape they never wrote.

The env is append-only and read last-write-wins, and an effect decl
re-registers its ops after the entry module's declarations. The measured
write order for spawn through the manifest is op, fn, fn, fn, op, op. The
op lands last; the fn loses.

That is why three iterations of reading sites failed. At the decl judgment
the env answers FnScheme; at the call it answers the op; by the time a
reader looks, one kind has already won. Two checks were built at reading
sites and reverted whole — both marched clean with census 0, neither fired.
E_FnShadowsOp reports at register_one_op's env write, the one place both
claims are present, with the span read from the losing entry's own Reason.

The kill that cost the most: both earlier probes ran through the micro
harness, whose blob link has no lib/runtime/threading, so spawn was only
ever a user fn there. Every reading was true and every reading was about a
program that did not have the defect. The gate inherited the same trap and
went red against a working fix — run_refusal pipes its fixture in on
stdin. It drives `compile <path>` now.

Prelude floor ceiling 6360 -> 6366, recorded: the class is six arms in
types.mn, 57% of that floor, and a class is content, not prose. Second such
event in three iterations, both types.mn — evidence for

two-top/ab745a0:
despawn_match reset only the resources the summary reads, so the next
session inherited the previous match's tail: a carried SimRng made
every second match's pickup schedule differ from a fresh boot (and
two re-paired online peers with different histories would desync on
it at the first spawn), a carried InputHistory made frame-1 edges
read against the last match's final buttons, live FireTrailCells
stayed lethal into the next match with no session left to expire
them, and the Crossing bridge / Reliquary door timers kept their old
cooldowns. Every rolled-back resource now resets and fire cells
despawn with the rest — the clean slate the function always claimed.

PracticeMode also stops surviving the exit. Leaving it armed made the
home page depend on how you arrived: a fresh boot showed FIND
OPPONENT with PRACTICE at rest, while the title after a bot match
showed PLAY with PRACTICE inverted — and the big button silently
started another bot match instead of matchmaking. Disarming on the
way out gives one home page regardless of the path; the bot-fallback
bounce through Title keeps its arm via PendingBotMatch, and the
gauntlet ladder lives in the persisted CareerRecord either way.
clob/abaa160:
Adds src/metrics/ with an EnergyMeter trait (TdpProxyMeter = wall-clock ×
TDP × load-average utilization, cached every 5s), a MetricsWindow that
accumulates per-step NLL, joules, and timing into flushed snapshots, and
a hand-rolled jsonl writer to keep serde_json out of the dependency tree
for a flat 10-field record.

Wires the window into cmd_ingest behind a --metrics-out flag. Every N
tokens (--metrics-window, default 500) the current window is snapshotted
and appended to the jsonl file; a MetricsSink helper owns the writer and
handles boundary flushing and the final partial window.

Adds `clob metrics --path X [--tail N]` which reads the jsonl and prints
a per-window table of tokens, seconds, J, J/nat, ΔJ/nat%, mean NLL,
Δmean_NLL, tok/s — with baseline taken from the first window so PR-level
comparisons have a stable reference. End-to-end verified on a 1500-token
ingest of tests/data/eval_corpus.txt against a synth small model;
five 300-token windows emitted, dashboard renders cleanly.

The window struct already carries holdout_nll, extra_steps, and
novel_tokens fields that Phase B+C and Phase D will populate — this
phase ships them as the empty/zero default so later phases are additive
rather than schema-breaking.

gain node both banks share — synth tails and sample tails end the same way,

register: banded noise with the double transient of a hand stroke. Both

mouth recorder targets, and the dice: fourfloor rolls open-hat offbeats and
steps the closed lane off those slots so the ring is audible, minimal rolls
